info.title: Clinic API — stage 3
info.description: Synthetic local implementation. No booking/schedule HTTP API or admin UI. HTTPS production uses __Host cookies; loopback HTTP development uses clinic_dev_session and clinic_dev_csrf. Fetch CSRF again after login/MFA token rotation. All mutations require exact Origin plus CSRF nonce cookie/header. MFA is mandatory for both roles. See AUTH.md for TTLs, rate limits and CLI operations.

SessionCookie.name: __Host-clinic_session
SessionCookie.description: HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax Path=/; opaque random token, never returned in JSON. TTL challenge 5m; authenticated 8h, idle 30m.

CsrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
